newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Disinflation to end in Portugal 1998-central bank.
newsitem.headline: Disinflation to end in Portugal 1998-central bank.

text.p: A trend of disinflation in Portugal will end in 1998, the central bank said in its annual report for 1996.
"For 1998, the Bank of Portugal expects an inflation level compatible with price stability. 1998 will be the conclusion of the process of disinflation in Portugal," it said.
"Once this process is concluded, the Bank of Portugal will have achieved a principal objective outlined in its statutes: the maintenance of price stability," it added.
Portugal's government has set a target for inflation of between 2.25 and 2.50 percent in 1997, down from 3.25 percent in 1996. It has not set a formal inflation target for 1998.
